workspaces.description:
图表原型库：7 种 Swift Charts 基础 Mark、23 种 ECharts 核心 series 与常用变体，以及 Vela OHLCV 蜡烛图、均线与技术指标；使用少量离线虚构数据，另保留 HTTP 和布局示例。图表与看板文案支持中英切换。
Chart gallery with all seven Swift Charts marks, 23 core ECharts series and common variants, plus Vela OHLCV candles and technical indicators. Uses small fictional offline datasets, with HTTP and layout examples. Chart and dashboard text follows the app's Chinese or English language setting.

en.description: Chart gallery with all seven Swift Charts marks, 23 core ECharts series and common variants, plus Vela OHLCV candles and technical indicators. Uses small fictional offline datasets, with HTTP and layout examples. Chart and dashboard text follows the app’s language setting.
en.title: Examples

zh-Hans.description: 图表原型库：7 种 Swift Charts 基础 Mark、23 种 ECharts 核心 series 与常用变体，以及 Vela OHLCV 蜡烛图、均线与技术指标；使用少量离线虚构数据，另保留 HTTP 和布局示例。图表与看板文案支持中英切换。
zh-Hans.title: 示例

resources.description:
12 个月的虚构经营数据，金额单位为万元。柱状图堆叠线上与门店收入，右轴显示利润率。
months 由 SQL 控制；target 绑定目标线；show_labels 直接绑定 ECharts 的 label.show。

en.description:
Twelve months of fictional business data, in units of CNY 10,000. Bars stack online and store revenue; the right axis shows profit margin.
SQL controls months; target sets the target line; show_labels binds directly to ECharts label.show.
en.title: ECharts · Revenue and profit margin

resources.description:
40 个交易日的离线虚构 OHLCV。K 线数据按 open、close、low、high 顺序绑定。
上下两个 grid 共享缩放；均线由 SQL 计算；成交量用 color_by 跟随当日涨跌。

en.description:
Forty trading days of fictional offline OHLCV data. Candlestick values are bound in open, close, low, high order.
The two grids share zoom; SQL calculates the moving average; color_by colors volume by the day’s price movement.
en.title: ECharts · Candlesticks and volume

resources.description:
与收入图共享 CSV source，SQL 将宽表转换为 [月份索引, 渠道索引, 数值]。
切换 revenue / profit 查看收入或分摊成本后的利润，单位为万元。色阶、标签和坐标轴均由 option 配置。
ECharts dataset 按渠道过滤为两组系列，让提示框同时显示月份、渠道与金额单位。

en.description:
Shares the revenue chart’s CSV source. SQL unpivots the data into [month index, channel index, value].
Choose revenue or profit after allocated costs, in units of CNY 10,000. The option defines the color scale, labels and axes.
ECharts dataset filters each channel into its own series so tooltips retain the month, channel and amount unit.
en.title: ECharts · Monthly channel heatmap
